scope: Permit the full axe audit to execute deferred browser work, while retaining deterministic native restart confirmation and focus assertions

edits.name: Run the full restart-review axe audit with its deferred timers resumed, then pause for deterministic confirmation
edits.old: await audit(page, 'restart-review'); const restartedAt = await page.evaluate(() => Date.now()); await page.keyboard.press('Space');
edits.new: await page.clock.resume(); await audit(page, 'restart-review'); await page.clock.pauseAt(new Date((await page.evaluate(() => Date.now())) + 1000)); await expect(confirm(page)).toBeFocused(); const restartedAt = await page.evaluate(() => Date.now()); await page.keyboard.press('Space');
